from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-6fc09535.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 8
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_lines + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_lines + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    # The non-divider background is the most frequent color in the grid.
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            if v != sep:
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    occupied = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            if any(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
                occupied.append((ri, ci))
    sri, sci = occupied[0]
    sr0, sr1 = row_spans[sri]
    sc0, sc1 = col_spans[sci]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            for dr in range(r1-r0):
                for dc in range(c1-c0):
                    v = grid[sr0+dr][sc0+dc]
                    if v != bg:
                        out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = v
    return out
'''
